purpose: Record the user-authorized priority for optional statistics after the frozen 638-job mainline. This file cannot launch transport.
user_direction: If the mainline finishes inside the original 16-hour window and disk remains, continue statistics in this order: parallel non-gamma replication, paper-style de-weighting, then incremental gamma.
mandatory_preconditions: The recovery0004 mainline is terminal and final_umbrella.recovery0004.json has PASS status and complete hash closure.
The current time is still before the original 16-hour hard deadline, with enough time to finish and validate the next complete shard or matched wave.
The original campaign byte cap and filesystem reserve remain satisfied; at least 20 GiB filesystem free space and the campaign emergency reserve are retained.

A separate write-once continuation authority freezes the new job plan, fresh collision-free seed registry, events, source hashes, geometry hashes, physics fingerprint, deadlines, resource caps, and publication namespace before any additional Cosima launch.
No mainline registry, receipt, seed, source, artifact, ledger, or authority is modified or overwritten.

ordered_phases.name: parallel_non_gamma_replication
contract: Allocate additional analogue Monte Carlo counts to non-photon families before any gamma increment, matching the M05 replicated-sample strategy for minority families.
Schedule balanced round-robin matched waves across family, geometry, and instant/BUILDUP mode so a wall-clock stop yields a valid balanced prefix rather than a single-family tail bias.

Keep the corrected full-support source cards unchanged; do not truncate energy tails, condition on detector outcomes, add track-level biasing, or change source flux, geometry, cuts, detector, materials, or physics.

Use fresh globally collision-free seeds. A matched Mass_model_511/S3d_O8 pair may share only its newly registered family/mode/ordinal seed under the continuation authority; failed exact retry keeps the same seed, source, and event count.

ordered_phases.name: paper_style_deweight_and_precision_check
contract: Replication changes sampling allocation, not physical flux. De-weight each independently normalized geometry/mode/family component by its own accumulated transported exposure.
For prompt observables, merge only within a fixed geometry/mode/family pool using sum(selected contribution) divided by sum(TT).
For BUILDUP, merge only within fixed geometry/mode/family/volume/isotope-state pools using sum(RP) divided by sum(TT); positive-TT zero-RP shards remain in the denominator.
Recompute rate weights, weighted uncertainty, effective sample size, zero-count limits, and geometry-pair precision closure before authorizing gamma increments.
Never pool raw event counts across families and never interpret replicated counts as additional physical exposure without this de-weighting.

ordered_phases.name: incremental_gamma
contract: Start gamma increments only after phases 1 and 2 have a validated continuation prefix and published de-weighting/precision checkpoint.
Use matched geometry/mode waves, fresh seeds, the same corrected full-spectrum analogue gamma source, and per-component TT normalization.
The retained unit_only_total_gamma spectrum already contains the broadband annihilation bump; do not add a mono-511 component.

resource_policy.scheduler: Reuse the independently audited recovery0004 live-MemAvailable admission policy unless a new continuation controller is separately frozen and audited.
resource_policy.stop_rule: Stop launching early enough to validate and publish the last complete continuation prefix before the original hard deadline; incomplete attempts remain preserved and non-mergeable.

write_scope.engineering: Only the batch0006 engineering package may receive new continuation controller, validator, and plan files.
write_scope.transport: Only a new append-only continuation namespace below this batch0006 run root may receive additional transport artifacts.
